title: Wo ein Wille ist, ist auch ein Weg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while still basking in the glory of our accomplishments…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In conclusion, we will arrive at Düsseldorf Airport five days from now at 1:40 p.m.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have completed all the paperwork and organized a schedule for us already. I shall assist with your preparations, so don't worry.
choice_data_list: …Could you run that by me again from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Of course. Überraschung, Trainer. Or, in other words… "Surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's be off to Germany.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's surprise is so sudden that I don't know what to say in response.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Was this too out of the blue? I had thought it best to inform you a year in advance…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, Falcon told me it would be better as a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Considering her expertise on how to have fun, I decided to heed her counsel…
choice_data_list: And turned this into a surprise instead?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. I already checked your schedule, so there should not be any conflicts, but just to be sure…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Will you be available from this date to this date?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Excellent. I wish to use that period for consultation, so please leave those dates open.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, she checked in with me about those dates before too—but she did it so naturally, I didn't suspect a thing…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I hope I'm not causing you any trouble with this…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My original plan three years ago was to return to Germany immediately after finishing my races.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, as I am still running in them, I have adjusted this to be a temporary visit.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I also had not accounted for having a travel companion in my original plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But as we worked together, I started wanting more and more to show you what my beloved homeland is like.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I intended to create the most enjoyable itinerary possible for the trip before we departed, but…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I failed to ascertain if you wanted to go in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I jumped to conclusions and assumed that you would be interested… It's a bad habit of mine.
choice_data_list: Of course I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I'd love to see your hometown, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then let's get ready for the trip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Eishin Flash and I begin preparing for our trip to Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It may be a bit chilly while we are there, so I recommend having a jacket on hand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I believe that alone should suffice, though. My parents said they will arrange for anything else you may require.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: They seem to be excited for your visit and are apparently replacing old furniture in preparation for your arrival.
choice_data_list: Th-they don't have to go that far.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I agree.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Only after leaving home did I come to understand that my parents are not the perfect people I believed them to be.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even so, I admire them immensely for all the efforts they put into achieving perfection and actually managing to do it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you are right. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now that you have decided what to bring, all that's left is to pack everything.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to take care of that for you. I assure you that your belongings will be perfectly packed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our preparations go smoothly until finally…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Here we are. We have arrived safely at Düsseldorf Airport. We're in Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Surely you jest. After seeing how soundly you were sleeping in the plane, I don't know if I believe you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Besides, there is no need for nerves. You have me with you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What other reason do you have to be nervous?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That's a relief. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my parents should be here to meet us, but—

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text: Flash! And there's her trainer!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh! There they are! Come!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's go!
